# owner: platform
"""Plain text absence notices for parents."""

from typing import Iterable

from rosterkit.models import Mark, Student
from rosterkit.attendance import days_missed

# ---
def build_notice(student: Student, marks: Iterable[Mark]) -> str:
    """Write a short notice listing the absent days, oldest first."""
    marks = list(marks)
    if any(mark.student_id != student.student_id for mark in marks):
        raise ValueError("marks belong to a different student")
    days = days_missed(marks)
    if not days:
        raise ValueError("no absences to report")
    dates = ", ".join(day.isoformat() for day in days)
    return f"{student.first_name} {student.last_name} missed {len(days)} day(s): {dates}."
after.tests/test_notices.py:
import unittest
from datetime import date

from rosterkit.models import Mark, Student
from rosterkit.notices import build_notice

STUDENT = Student("s1", "Lovelace", "Ada", "A")


class NoticeTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_lists_absences_in_order(self):
        marks = [
            Mark("s1", date(2026, 9, 5), "absent"),
            Mark("s1", date(2026, 9, 2), "absent"),
            Mark("s1", date(2026, 9, 3), "present")
        ]
        text = build_notice(STUDENT, marks)
        self.assertIn("Ada Lovelace", text)
        self.assertIn("2 day(s): 2026-09-02, 2026-09-05", text)

    def test_other_student(self):
        marks = [Mark("s2", date(2026, 9, 2), "absent")]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            build_notice(STUDENT, marks)

    def test_no_absences(self):
        marks = [Mark("s1", date(2026, 9, 2), "excused")]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            build_notice(STUDENT, marks)
